title: China launches free AI avatar generator with lip sync and #chinaai #aavatarlaunch #aitechnology
description: China released a free, open-source AI avatar generator that creates fully talking avatars from a single photo and audio clip. It features perfect lip sync, smooth facial expressions, full body motion, and supports multiple people in one scene while maintaining character consistency. This tool runs locally with ComfyUI or can be tested online without any payment or restrictions, offering a powerful alternative to existing software like Heijin. Its accessibility and advanced capabilities signal a shift in AI-driven avatar creation, enabling broader use in content production, virtual communication, and digital entertainment. The open-source nature invites developers and creators to innovate freely, driving further advancements in AI-generated avatars and interactive media. #AIAvatarGenerator #OpenSourceAI #ChinaAI #ComfyUI #DigitalAvatars #AIInnovation #AvatarCreation #LipSyncAI #MotionCapture #VirtualCharacters #HeijinAlternative #AIContentCreation #ArtificialIntelligence #3DAnimation #AIavatars
